subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Overcharging Taxi Scams
description: A quick win: understand Overcharging Taxi Scams.

hook.text: A taxi ride from the airport costs you $80. Other passengers paid $15 for the same route.

buildup.text: Tourist taxi scams include rigged meters, scenic detours, and flat-rate traps.

discovery.text: Some drivers use modified meters that run two or three times faster than the legal rate.

twist.text: Ride-sharing apps reduced taxi scams dramatically — but some cities have banned them.

climax.text: Knowing the approximate fare and insisting on the meter is the simplest defense.

punchline.text: The scenic route costs extra — and you never asked for it.

quiz.question: How do some taxi drivers overcharge tourists?
options: They use modified meters that run faster than the legal rate
